ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (43) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 17, 31 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Одиночество» (odinochestvo, 'solitude, loneliness') is 'solitude' throughout, as in the title, and «одинок» (odinok) 'alone'; the two verse passages (Musset, Sully Prudhomme) are translated from the Russian, which the website draft had omitted. Paris names take their established forms (Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe de l'Étoile for «Триумфальная арка Звезды», Triumfal'naya arka Zvezdy, 'Triumphal Arch of the Star', Place de la Concorde).
Source observation: [15] Stray asterisks «**» before «нет и выхода» ('there is no way out'); ignored in the English.
Source observation: [41] The final sentence has no closing period in the source; the English supplies it.
